Travel now
Ready to go? Get inspired by these hot travel ideas.
The Viking Row: Norway’s viral football fan tradition
Discover the Norwegian Viking Row, Norway’s playful fan ritual inspired by Vikings, the country's deep rowing traditions, fjords, fishing, traveling and the Norwegian connection to the sea.
Road trip map for foodies
Here’s the ultimate food guide to the best restaurants and cafés on a road trip in Norway, including eateries with local dishes, artisan bakeries, top restaurants and hidden gems.
The best Viking sites
Experience the top Viking attractions in Norway. From newly discovered Viking ships to exciting Viking villages and high-tech exhibitions – here are some of Norway’s most interesting Viking sites.
Along selected roads in Norway, natural wonders are amplified by art, design, and architecture meant to bring you closer to nature in new and surprising ways. Meet the award-winning Scenic Routes.
Unique places to stay
Accommodation that is an experience in itself. Check out our selection of some of Norway’s most unique hotel alternatives, from yurts and lighthouses to parked trains and treehouses.
Top 10 destinations in Norway
From hip urban cities to glittering fjords, northern lights, and remote villages above the Arctic Circle – Norway is packed with things to see and do. So, where do you start? To get the most out of your holiday, we recommend that you choose one or two regions to explore. Here are some of the highlights!
Family fun
You’ve seen the fjords and the northern lights, and tasted all kinds of exotic Norwegian food. Now it’s the children’s turn ...
Norway's hidden fjord gems
Why go where everyone else goes? Here are eight unique fjord regions in Western Norway to put on your list! From the small Jøssingfjord in the south to the mountainous Hjørundfjord in the north.
Beyond the hotspots
Visit the most popular destinations like the Geirangerfjord, the Flåm Railway, Lofoten, and Tromsø off season, or discover quieter, but just as stunning, alternatives and hidden gems!
Michelin-starred restaurants
Sink your teeth into tasty and exclusive Nordic culinary treasures at Norway's incredible Michelin-starred restaurants.
Exciting new experiences in 2026
Are you ready for some WOW? Check out new, unique places to stay, fun experiences and relaxing spas.
Hidden gems east of Oslo – weekend getaway
The Oslo region offers plenty of excellent weekend breaks. Rømskog hotel, Kongsvinger Fortress hotel, the Plus, Magnor Glass Factory, beautiful nature, local patisseries, and cute alpacas are just some of the things waiting for you!
The wooden house towns
Go on a journey through the charming wooden house towns of Southern Norway, learn about their unique history and discover cosy cafés, charming art galleries, and tasty local food.
Top lists
Top hikes, top places to stay, top activities and more. Find the very best Norway has to offer through our top lists.
Norway – a world class art destination
Norway is an excellent destination for art lovers. Experience The Scream by Edvard Munch in Oslo, the incredible sculpture park in Kistefos Museum, or enjoy one of Northern Europe’s most innovative art institutions, Kunstsilo.
The Vigeland Sculpture park
The Vigeland Park is a public sculpture park located within Frogner Park in Oslo. The park features more than 200 sculptures by Norwegian sculptor Gustav Vigeland, depicting human figures in various stages of life and relationships.
Plan your dream holiday
National scenic hikes
Trolltunga, Preikestolen, Kjerag, Fosseråsa and Besseggen are some of Norway's best hikes. National Hiking Trail status makes sure they will last for many years to come!
Wildlife safaris
Wildlife safaris bring you safely into a unique animal kingdom. Get close to whales, king crabs, the shaggy survivor from the last glacial epoch – the musk ox, and more!
Kayaking
Get up close to stunning Norwegian fjord and coastal landscapes on a paddling adventure! Here are some of the hotspots you won't want to miss.
Top 11 experiences for a real KICK!
Do you have a need for speed? Here are 11 activities in Norway that will get your adrenaline pumping, from surfing and ziplines to rafting and RIB rides.
Climbing
Nothing beats the utter exhilaration of completing a climb. But bear in mind, some dizzying Norwegian mountain peaks and frozen waterfalls are not for the feint of heart.
Rafting
Rafting enthusiasts from all over the world travel to Norway, and for a good reason. Norwegian rivers offer all kinds of challenges for every ability.
Surfing
Surf's up in Norway! Enjoy Arctic adventures, untamed nature, and uncrowded waves. Here are some of the hot spots.
Cycling
Go coastal biking, mountain biking, or road biking! Exploring Norway by bike is a fantastic holiday experience, with plenty of unforgettable cycling routes.
Horse riding
Saddle up – and take a ride with us through some of the most scenic places in Norway.
Hiking
Go hiking in Norway and discover the world's most beautiful nature by foot. Walk along the coast, hike through a forest, or climb a massive mountain – the scenic views will make it well worth your while.

This is Norway
Live your best life with kos and friluftsliv, and discover centuries of amazing architecture.
Norwegian Vikings
The Vikings have earned their place in history as a seafaring warrior culture with a fine eye for design and a good ear for storytelling.
Norway’s UNESCO sites
From ancient petroglyphs to mighty fjord landscapes and early industrial sites: Nine Norwegian landmarks and areas are included in the UNESCO World Heritage List of the world’s most important natural and cultural sites.
Explore Norway’s 5 UNESCO Global Geoparks. Journey through a landscape shaped by volcanoes, glaciers and oceans millions of years ago.
Stave churches
Elaborately carved wooden churches were once abundant. Today, they are almost exclusively found in Norway.
Typically Norwegian
Discover why Norwegians are among the happiest people on earth. Learn the noble art of kos, taste some weird and wonderful food, join us in celebrating our favourite holidays, and get a closer look at those fierce Vikings!
Experience Sami culture
From ancient sounds, traditional handicrafts, and a long-standing reindeer culture to a modern, revitalised identity and a vibrant cultural scene. Discover the Sami – the proud indigenous people of the North.
UNESCO-listed folk music
Discover the unique folk music of Setesdal in Southern Norway, recognised by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage. Experience traditional instruments like the Hardingfele (Hardanger fiddle) and Munnharpe (jaw harp), alongside modern takes on Norwegian folk music.
Get to know the Norwegian Fjord Horse
The Norwegian national horse originates in Fjord Norway. It’s quite small, but strong – and has the most punk rock hair in the whole stable!
Waffle is the king of kos
In Norway, it’s always waffle-time. In fact, we love waffles so much that we even serve them in the shape of a heart. Try it as a sweet treat or a cutting-edge Michelin dish.
Friluftsliv: Our love for the outdoors
The concept of friluftsliv – or “outdoor life” – is as Norwegian as cross-country skis and woollen sweaters. Learn how it can make you a happier person.
Norwegian wood architecture
The wood built Norway and provided us shelter for thousands of years. Its history and traditions are still alive. And now, more than ever in the Norwegian architecture!
‘Kos’ = having a good time!
Norway’s mighty nature and distinct seasons bring people together to create intimate moments of cosiness. Learn more about how to experience kos for yourself!
The Norwegian Cookbook
Get inspired by Norwegian cuisine! Try traditional and innovative recipes from the all over the country for everything from seafood, meat, and vegetables to waffles, pastries and more.

Hurtigruten – the coastal highway to the north
Take a trip with Hurtigruten – the Norwegian coastal express that has sailed from port to port along one of the world’s most beautiful coastlines for more than 125 years.
Experience Sami culture
From ancient sounds, traditional handicrafts, and a long-standing reindeer culture to a modern, revitalised identity and a vibrant cultural scene. Discover the Sami – the proud indigenous people of the North.
The raw rebirth of the joik
Young Sami performers are breathing new life to one of Europe’s oldest song traditions. Ancient sounds meet modern genres, ushering in a new wave of internationally acclaimed musicians.
The echo of The Scream
Visit the spot in Oslo where Edvard Munch found inspiration for one of the world’s most famous paintings: The Scream.
The world-famous painter Edvard Munch
Edvard Munch earned his place in history with art influenced by his restless soul and the Norwegian nature. Meet the creator of the iconic masterpiece The Scream.
The Vigeland Sculpture park
The Vigeland Park is a public sculpture park located within Frogner Park in Oslo. The park features more than 200 sculptures by Norwegian sculptor Gustav Vigeland, depicting human figures in various stages of life and relationships.
Kon-Tiki
A new exhibition at the Kon-Tiki Museum in Oslo brings the story of explorer Thor Heyerdahl into the present through interactive exhibits, lesser-known stories, and the perspective of his granddaughter, Liv Heyerdahl.
Norwegian wood architecture
The wood built Norway and provided us shelter for thousands of years. Its history and traditions are still alive. And now, more than ever in the Norwegian architecture!
Experience the Bergen Railway with the Locomotwins
Meet the Locomotwins and join them on the journey from Oslo to Bergen with the Bergen Railway.
Norway – cradle of skiing
They say that Norwegian are born with skis on their feet. Learn all about the history and our love of skiing!

Kunstsilo – Southern Norway's new art destination
A former grain silo has been transformed into one of Northern Europe's most innovative powerhouses for art and cultural experiences. See what you can experience now!
Along selected roads in Norway, natural wonders are amplified by art, design, and architecture meant to bring you closer to nature in new and surprising ways. Meet the award-winning Scenic Routes.
Norway’s most exclusive hotels
From five-star luxury and chic boutique hotels to grand manor houses and historic gems – step inside Norway’s most exclusive accommodation.
Unforgettable treetop houses
Sleep in a comfortable bed surrounded by the deep tranquility of the forest. Spend a night or two in one of the many unforgettable treehouses located throughout Norway.
Unique places to stay
Accommodation that is an experience in itself. Check out our selection of some of Norway’s most unique hotel alternatives, from yurts and lighthouses to parked trains and treehouses.
Quirky museums
Did you know that there are lots of quirky museums in Norway? Explore amazing everything from incredible optical illusions to stockfish and Vikings!
An island escape that says WOW!
Your choice of travel can make a difference! Come along to the island paradise of Nordskot in Steigen, a short, scenic express boat ride from Bodø! Stay in one-of-a-kind  places like Manshausen, Naustholmen or Villa Haugen, and support the local community.
Taste Lofoten: Star chef Mymint's guide
Want an authentic taste of Lofoten? Meet Siriyaporn 'Mymint' Rithisirikrerg, one of the most talented young chefs in Norway. She works at Thon Hotel in Svolvær in Lofoten, where local talent meets bold innovation.
